_doc: An example of the journey apps file. Your own copy goes to ~/.config/claude-annotate/journey/apps.json (JOURNEY_APPS names another file); when that exists it replaces this one.
name: what the canvas calls the app. scopes: the comment box's choice, or null for none.
canvas: the folder the app publishes its canvas into; it is the page of the app's webcompanion session (kind journey, slug = the app).
features: where the feature ids come from. gherkin: a journey.feature's Scenarios as slugs (@skip kept), relative to the sandbox, else the session home.

run: argv that runs features and publishes them; {features} is the chosen ids, nothing for every feature; {cli} is the app CLI (config `cli`, under config `home`); {home} is the session home. The run runs in the session home; the CLI picks the sandbox and never makes one.
after: argv run once the run ends, whatever its result (null for none). env: added to the run's environment.
results: the folder, relative to the sandbox, whose <feature>/manifest.json the run writes (status, finishedAt, boards, error).
